metadata.title: Pinhaoji Cloud | Affordable, Reliable Global Cloud Infrastructure
metadata.description: Pinhaoji Cloud provides developers, startups and enterprises with cost-effective, highly available cloud servers, networking and storage. Predictable cost, stable operations, from web hosting to production workloads.

hero.subtitle: A global cloud services brand. Get reliable cloud capabilities at a reasonable cost — on-demand, stable and predictable infrastructure for websites, APIs and enterprise workloads.

items.q: How do I request a trial?
items.a: Submit the contact form and our team will reach out within one business day to confirm your scenario and arrange a trial or demo.
The first release supports pay-as-you-go billing based on actual usage. Prices and details follow official product documentation and terms.

items.q: How do I migrate existing workloads?
items.a: Common images and standard deployment flows are supported, plus migration consulting. For complex cases, contact sales for architecture guidance.
24/7 tickets and email support; scope and response time follow official terms of service.

items.q: How is my data stored and protected?
items.a: Data is stored in the region you select or agree on. Purpose, retention and deletion channels are described in the Privacy Policy and Terms.
Availability targets and SLA commitments follow signed, deliverable terms — marketing pages make no promises beyond contracts.
